name: cancel_outcome
description: Cancel an outcome order by its attestation hash. Steps not yet sent to a provider stop and their credits return; jobs already running finish and are charged only if they succeed (a failure is refunded automatically). Answers 200 when done and 202 while jobs finish (repeat it, or set waitSeconds up to 25); repeating is safe. Re-running a cancelled order is refused for an hour; send a new client_reference to order the same brief again. A run without an outcome hold answers 409 legacy_run with a generation cancel per reserved step. Unauthenticated production returns NOT_LIVE.

hash.description: SHA-256 attestation hash from quote or execute.

waitSeconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds for running jobs to finish before answering.
